combo_label: Emergency Services × Horses & Riding × The Titanic

entries.clue: Boat, Promenade and Bridge were three of her stacked levels
One of three screws astern, the middle one turned by a turbine, the outers by pistons
Rocking three-beat pace, named for the amble of pilgrims to Becket's shrine
Ridden ballet of collected paces and figures, each movement marked out of ten
Chest compressions and rescue breaths, known by three letters
Ring of tape and officers holding onlookers back from a scene
Numbered disc on an old telephone, turned three times over to raise 999
Cheapest quarters low in the ship; three of every four booked there were lost
Plainest sort of bit, working by direct pull with no leverage; also, to pinch
Drifting mountain calved off a Greenland glacier, sighted with no time to spare
